---
title: "Newsletter"
description: "One email for each new issue."
---

Subscribers get one email when a new issue of the Monitor or of Commentary is out: a short summary and a link to the full issue on this site. Nothing else is sent.

The list runs on Substack. Your email address is used only to send the newsletter, and you can unsubscribe from any email. See the [privacy policy](../legal/privacy.qmd).
